keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Job title, keywords, or skills to search for. Leave empty for everything.

location.title: Location
location.description: City, state, or region for location-based searches.

country.title: Country (ISO-2)
country.description: Two-letter ISO country code (e.g. US, CA, GB, DE).

radiusMiles.title: Radius (miles)
radiusMiles.description: Search radius in miles around the specified location.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within
postedWithinDays.description: Filter jobs posted within the last N days.

remoteOnly.title: Remote only
remoteOnly.description: Only include remote or work-from-home job postings.

workModes.title: Work arrangement
workModes.description: Filter by specific work arrangements (remote, hybrid, onsite).

minSalary.title: Min annual salary
minSalary.description: Applied natively where supported (Indeed, LinkedIn, Glassdoor, ZipRecruiter, SimplyHired) and as a post-filter everywhere.

requireEquity.title: Require equity / stock options
requireEquity.description: Only return jobs that explicitly offer stock options, RSUs, or equity compensation.

seniorityLevels.title: Seniority levels
seniorityLevels.description: Filter jobs matching specific career seniority tiers (senior, lead, staff, principal, etc.).

minYearsExperience.title: Min years experience
minYearsExperience.description: Filter out jobs requiring less than this number of years of experience.

maxYearsExperience.title: Max years experience
maxYearsExperience.description: Filter out jobs requiring more than this number of years of experience.

skillsInclude.title: Must include skills
skillsInclude.description: Jobs must require all of these technical skills (e.g. React, TypeScript, GraphQL, AWS).

skillsExclude.title: Must NOT include skills
skillsExclude.description: Disqualify jobs that mention any of these unwanted skills or legacy tech.

directApplyOnly.title: Direct company ATS only
directApplyOnly.description: Filter out recruiters and agency middlemen; only return direct company ATS applications (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday).

maxApplicants.title: Max applicant threshold
maxApplicants.description: Exclude postings that already exceeded this number of applicants (e.g. max 50 applicants on LinkedIn/Indeed).

descriptionInclude.title: Description must contain (keywords)
descriptionInclude.description: Full-text description keyword matching (e.g. '401k match', 'unlimited PTO', 'visa sponsorship').

descriptionExclude.title: Description must NOT contain (keywords)
descriptionExclude.description: Exclude jobs whose descriptions contain these phrases (e.g. 'on-call 24/7', 'security clearance required').

employmentTypes.title: Employment types
employmentTypes.description: Filter by employment types (full-time, part-time, contract, internship, freelance, temporary).

sources.title: Boards
sources.description: List of job boards and ATS sources to query.

maxResultsPerSource.title: Max results per board
maxResultsPerSource.description: Maximum number of jobs to fetch per individual job board source.

startUrls.title: Search URLs (optional)
startUrls.description: Paste any board search URL straight from your browser (Indeed, LinkedIn, Glassdoor, etc.) or a Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby board. Board is auto-detected; tracking params are stripped; replaces that board's generated search. Unknown sites use JSON-LD auto-extraction.

companyBoards.title: Company ATS boards
companyBoards.description: Direct ATS company boards (e.g. greenhouse:stripe, lever:palantir, ashby:ramp, smartrecruiters:visa).

fetchDetails.title: Fetch full descriptions
fetchDetails.description: Perform an extra request per job on LinkedIn/BuiltIn/Indeed to fetch full descriptions, seniority, salary, and applicant counts.

titleInclude.title: Title must match (regex)
titleInclude.description: Filter jobs whose titles match at least one of these regular expressions or keywords.

titleExclude.title: Title must NOT match (regex)
titleExclude.description: Exclude jobs whose titles match any of these regular expressions or keywords.

excludeCompanies.title: Exclude companies
excludeCompanies.description: List of company names to filter out completely from results.

keepUnknownSalary.title: Keep jobs with no salary listed
keepUnknownSalary.description: When minSalary is set, whether to keep jobs that have no listed salary information.

onlyNew.title: Only new since last run
onlyNew.description: Only return jobs not previously seen in past runs. Ideal for scheduled daily alert runs.

stateKey.title: State key
stateKey.description: Namespace identifier for tracking seen jobs per distinct search query.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy (API/HTTP boards)
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy configuration for HTTP and API boards. Helps avoid rate limits.

browserProxyConfiguration.title: Proxy (protected boards)
browserProxyConfiguration.description: Proxy configuration for protected browser boards (Indeed, Glassdoor, ZipRecruiter, etc.). Residential proxy is strongly recommended.

maxConcurrency.title: HTTP concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of simultaneous HTTP requests for API-based scrapers.

browserMaxConcurrency.title: Browser concurrency
browserMaxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of simultaneous headless browser instances.

maxRequestRetries.title: Retries
maxRequestRetries.description: Maximum number of retries per failed HTTP or browser request.

diceApiKey.title: Dice API key
diceApiKey.description: Public API key for Dice search API.

debug.title: Debug logs
debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging for all scraper stages.
